subject: firmly raises $15M Series A with J.P. Morgan Payments and Mastercard
text:
Source: https://www.pymnts.com/news/artificial-intelligence/2026/firmly-lands-15-million-as-investors-back-the-merchant-side-of-agentic-commerce/ (PYMNTS, 5 Nov 2026). Readable. The GlobeNewswire release (https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/11/05/3396499/0/en/firmly-raises-15-million-series-a-and-launches-ask-agent-to-help-merchants-more-easily-adopt-agentic-commerce.html) returns HTTP 403, so don't use it.

Readable in PYMNTS: firmly, a Seattle startup that connects merchants to AI shopping channels without code, raised $15 million in a Series A led by Squarepoint Capital. J.P. Morgan Payments, Mastercard and Samsung Next joined as strategic investors, along with Alumni Ventures. firmly Connect "can already reach more than 11 million merchants representing more than $900 billion" in gross merchandise volume. It launched Ask Agent, a conversational shopping experience merchants add to their own sites. Mastercard named firmly a partner in September for Agent Connect. Credit figures to the company's release as PYMNTS does ("the release said").

Not readable, so leave out: total funding of about $20M (Site Watch's figure; not in PYMNTS).
